topic: Olsson logarithmic Clustered Forward+ Z-slicing vs linear view-space depth slice starvation rig
topic_zh: Olsson 对数自相似分簇前向渲染（Clustered Forward+）深度切片对比线性深度第 0 片 12× 拥堵
scope: Deterministic Olsson, Billeter & Assarsson (HPG 2012) logarithmic/self-similar frustum Z-slicing (s(z) = floor(ln(z)*scale + bias)) versus naive linear view-space depth slicing and explicit plane-array search across 17 frustum depth slices (z in [0.10, 1000.0] m). No neural light culling execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. O(1) precomputed scale-and-bias logarithmic slice lookup floor(ln(z)*scale + bias) versus geometric plane-array construction and search.

protocol.function: s(z) = ⌊ln(z)·scale + bias⌋, z_k = z_near·(z_far/z_near)^(k/N_z) → Slice Occupancy ≡ 1.00×

robustness.name: Sampled 17 frustum depth slices preserve self-similar aspect ratio 1.7191 and exact 1/1 light band occupancy

good_fit: Clustered Forward+ and Clustered Deferred 3D froxel light culling grids (DOOM idTech, Three.js WebGPU, Godot 4, Unreal Strata)
Explaining why linear Z-slicing (Δz = 58.82m) dumps 12/17 near-to-mid depth bands into Slice 0 while leaving 11 slices empty
Maintaining cubical self-similar 3D froxels (Δz/z = const) across a 10,000:1 perspective depth range
Evaluating slice indices in O(1) via floor(ln(z) * scale + bias) using two precomputed camera uniforms
not_for: Orthographic 2D side-scrollers where frustum width does not expand with depth z
Single-directional-light outdoor scenes without point or spot light culling grids
Neural light importance sampling or ReSTIR reservoir resampling networks
Baked static lightmaps with zero dynamic runtime point lights
